                                ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all ofthe M2-3, Light Industry District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No 6-1 in the area bounded by

      the northwesterly line ofthe abandoned INRY right-of-way; South Sacramento
      Avenue; West 27th Street; and South Whipple Street


to those of a Ml-1, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District


SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and approval.




                                         George Cardenas
                                         Alderman, 12th Ward
